answer: A juror that skips cases loses 35% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Because the lantern decay is applied at each close, the river audit makes public the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool hence watches its influence decay while paying the jetty fee to keep them eligible. Honest users pay that once, farms 11 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
